notes: No candidate was cloned, built or analyzed. gh api reads only. Forbidden inputs not read.
Runtimes: Next.js, Node x3, Python, Go x2, Rust x3 (SQLPage, rustypaste, rauthy). Root Dockerfile present for all 10.
spliit Risk: Prisma migrations at start; optional S3 receipt storage; compose.yaml is dev oriented; Next build may need DB env at build time.
misskey Risk: .config/default.yml must be provided at runtime (DB/Redis hosts); pnpm monorepo, heavy build; optional object storage; Redis required; default branch develop.
shynet Risk: last push 2026-03, slow maintenance; Celery worker and webserver run as separate modes; Postgres required; many env vars (DB, Django hosts); nginx.conf sidecar.
mailpit Risk: SMTP port is TCP non-HTTP so health check only on 8025; Dockerfile may copy a prebuilt binary (goreleaser); default branch develop; data in sqlite file.
tianji Risk: large pnpm monorepo, memory-heavy build; Prisma migrations; optional ClickHouse; JWT_SECRET env required.
wakapi Risk: default DB is SQLite in data dir; Postgres via WAKAPI_DB_* envs; entrypoint.sh drops privileges; config.default.yml; optional SMTP.

sqlpage Risk: it is a server that serves .sql files from a mounted dir, so app content must be supplied (repo has only examples/ and sqlpage/ dirs); needs DATABASE_URL; npm frontend build in build.rs; compose points at multiple DBs.
rustypaste Risk: config.toml with auth_tokens must be provided or auth is off; uploads on local disk (storage need); no Postgres; multi stage Rust build.

rauthy Risk: Dockerfile may copy prebuilt binary/assets (Dockerfile_builder exists); config.toml with secrets (encryption keys, bootstrap admin) required; embedded Hiqlite default so Postgres is optional; frontend build step.
kener Risk: default DB SQLite; Postgres via DATABASE_URL; Redis optional; docker-entrypoint.sh runs migrations; KENER_SECRET_KEY and ORIGIN env required.
CI: kener has failure=1 check run at pinned commit. Informational only.
